name: markdown-image-paste-for-remote
description: inserting images into Markdown files while working in a remote host, such as GitHub Codespaces or a DevContainer.

markdownImagePasteForRemote.editorPaste..markdownDescription: Save images pasted into a Markdown editor (Ctrl+V / ⌘V) to `#markdownImagePasteForRemote.imagePath#` and insert a link to them. Works in GitHub Codespaces and remote hosts. If VS Code's built-in Markdown image paste is used instead, add `markdown.link.image.remote` to `#editor.pasteAs.preferences#`.

markdownImagePasteForRemote.imagePath.markdownDescription:
Directory to save pasted images to. Relative paths are resolved from the directory of the current Markdown file.

Available variables:
- `${currentFileDir}`: directory of the current file (with trailing separator)
- `${currentFileName}`: current file name with extension
- `${currentFileNameWithoutExt}`: current file name without extension
- `${projectRoot}`: workspace folder that contains the current file (with trailing separator)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
